title: Family-Adjustment Relief on TRICARE Reserve Select Adjustment Bills
content:
**TRICARE Premium-Based Plans - TRICARE Reserve Select.**

When a coverage-type adjustment has been billed on a TRICARE Reserve Select plan for the most recently paid coverage month and the purchaser's active duty TRICARE coverage carried days of the period that adjustment covers, the adjustment bill owes a family-adjustment relief for those days, posted against it as an activation-on-orders credit. The paid-bill condition for credits is set aside only for a family-adjustment relief, which is posted against such a bill although no payment stands against it; every other credit on the plan still needs a payment posted against its bill.

## Effect on the account

The relief is one credit entry, with reason activation on orders, tied to the coverage-type adjustment bill and its coverage month. It lowers the plan's premium balance by the amount relieved, whether or not a payment stands against that adjustment bill.

## Posting action: `relieve_family_adjustment_280360d9`

**Capability.** The action posts an activation-on-orders credit on a TRICARE Reserve Select plan against a coverage-type adjustment bill, relieving the added family premium for the days that bill covers on which the purchaser's active duty TRICARE coverage also covered the family; the bill need not carry a payment. One call books one credit entry (reason: activation on orders) tied to the named adjustment bill and coverage month, and lowers the plan's premium balance by the relieved amount.

**How it is invoked.** `relieve_family_adjustment_280360d9` is an agent-side action: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `premium_enrollment_id` | reference number of the premium-based plan, as returned by the premium-plan lookup for the purchaser | identifier |
| `related_premium_entry_id` | reference number of the coverage-type adjustment bill the credit is posted against, as returned by the premium-ledger lookup for the plan | identifier |
| `coverage_month` | coverage month of that bill, exactly as the bill shows it | YYYY-MM |
| `coverage_days` | number of days of that month the credit covers | integer from 1 to 31 |
| `amount` | the credit amount in USD, already rounded to the cent; it is booked exactly as given | positive number with 2 decimal places |

**Return.** The receipt is a dictionary rendered as text with `premium_entry_id` (reference number of the new credit entry), `premium_enrollment_id` (the plan), `related_premium_entry_id` (the bill credited), `coverage_month` (YYYY-MM), `coverage_days` (integer), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `adjustment_reason` (always `activation_on_orders`), `premium_balance_due` (the plan's premium balance in USD after the credit; a negative figure means money is owed to the purchaser) and `status` ("posted" once the credit is booked).
